platform.rationale: The edition is curated (specific seeds); random-at-mint launchpads would discard the selection. Artist-owned contract, batch mint of predetermined tokens with pinned images, generator archived.

chain.rationale: Strongest provenance and collector expectation for a 256-piece curated edition; gas accepted.

reserves.rationale: 12 artist proofs (highest score per style) and 12 institutional reserves (lowest-numbered plan-and-section per style); auditable like the selection.

licence.rationale: Holders and the public may share and display with attribution; commercial rights and the series identity stay with the artist; the repository stays public for verification.

title.rationale: Already frozen into every sheet's schedule and DWG ids; no re-freeze needed.

artist.derivation: Isopsephy (the Milesian letter-number system) of the artist's name: Δημήτρης = Δ4 η8 μ40 ή8 τ300 ρ100 η8 ς200 = 668; Μάρης = Μ40 ά1 ρ100 η8 ς200 = 349. Attic acrophonic: ΗΗΗΗΗΗΔΔΔΔΔΔΠΙΙΙ and ΗΗΗΔΔΔΔΠΙΙΙΙ.
artist.note: Appears in metadata and on the collection page only, never on the frozen sheets. DA-MA-TE (Demeter's Linear B form) was excluded for name collisions.

archive.form: 256 zips (one per token: canonical PNG, companion PNG, metadata JSON) + SHA256SUMS.zips + manifest.json + verify.sh
archive.verification: verify.sh on the drive: 256 zip hashes OK, 769 entries extracted, all 768 files match manifest.json
archive.regeneration: byte-identical from the frozen generator with tools/strata-export.mjs and Playwright 1.56.1 (see README)
